name: Rumpel
source:
"To be romantic and loving...that is the epitome of goodness. Show someone affection and they will return it twofold."

A flirtatious man that is chivalrous to every single woman he meets. His playful and melodramatic personality often gives people the impression that he is very immature.

Currently suffering from amnesia that is caused by his curse. He does not seem particularly bothered by his lack of memories.

[From [url=http://dicesuki.tumblr.com/post/147859949560/the-plot-summary-and-character-bios-are-here-what]official[/url] [url=http://dicesuki.tumblr.com/post/148343332775/hi-everyone-heres-more-information-about-the]blog[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Chevalier Du Mont.[/spoiler]
